title: 82nd Airborne Division War Memorial Museum

buildingCutout.basis: Named public museum outline cross-checked against North Carolina surveyed roofline 2787736.

terrainReference.basis: Original terrain immediately outside the measured public approach projection.

mapIdentity.provider: Named OpenStreetMap museum outline 1283505518 corroborated by NCDPS roofline 2787736.
mapIdentity.scope: Seventeen named OpenStreetMap perimeter vertices in way 1283505518 are corroborated by 19 points of North Carolina Emergency Management roofline 2787736. The museum operator identifies building C-6841 at 5108 Ardennes Street. The two article pins are about 2.4 km from the physical museum.

note: The Army Center of Military History article by the museum director identifies the purpose-built 1957 building and three major additions. The museum operator confirms the same site and current visitor building. The roofline plan identifies the approach pavilion and folded rear wings; the low envelope heights and public entry treatment are estimated.
